search.title: 3–4 Bedroom Houses · Abbey Wood & the Elizabeth line to Canary Wharf

branches.name: Southeastern branch — Abbey Wood → Canary Wharf
branches.blurb: The affordable, direct run into Canary Wharf. Your headline area.

stations.name: Abbey Wood
stations.note: Elizabeth line terminus. Best value 3/4-bed houses in this whole search.

stations.name: Woolwich
stations.note: Riverside regeneration around Woolwich Arsenal; terraces just south of the station.

stations.name: Custom House
stations.note: Closest affordable stop to the Wharf — houses are scarce here, mostly new-build flats.

branches.name: Eastern branch — Stratford → Shenfield
branches.blurb: Every stop runs direct to Canary Wharf. Space-per-pound improves the further east you go.

stations.name: Stratford
stations.note: Houses are tight at £450k; look to the Forest Gate / Maryland fringes.

stations.name: Maryland
stations.note: Victorian terraces; walkable to Stratford.

stations.name: Forest Gate
stations.note: Popular terraced streets, strong value for 3-beds.

stations.name: Manor Park
stations.note: Larger Edwardian houses; some 4-beds within budget.

stations.name: Ilford
stations.note: Wide stock of 3/4-bed terraces and semis.

stations.name: Seven Kings
stations.note: Family terraces, good value.

stations.name: Goodmayes
stations.note: Semis and terraces, quieter streets.

stations.name: Chadwell Heath
stations.note: More garden space per pound.

stations.name: Romford
stations.note: Big market town; broad choice of houses.

stations.name: Gidea Park
stations.note: Sought-after; 3-beds more likely than 4 at budget.

stations.name: Harold Wood
stations.note: Newer estates plus older semis.

stations.name: Brentwood
stations.note: Essex commuter town; budget stretches to semis.

stations.name: Shenfield
stations.note: Eastern terminus; most space per pound on the line.

branches.name: Western branch — Southall → Reading
branches.blurb: Also direct to Canary Wharf. Outer stops where a £450k house is realistic.

stations.name: Southall
stations.note: Terraces and semis; strong value.

stations.name: Hayes & Harlington
stations.note: 3-bed terraces within budget.

stations.name: West Drayton
stations.note: Semis and estates near the station.

stations.name: Slough
stations.note: Wide choice; budget reaches semis.

stations.name: Twyford
stations.note: Village feel; 3-beds achievable.

stations.name: Reading
stations.note: Western terminus; more house for the money.
